reviews.review:
Well, well, well…
I had to refund the game because it required so much power that I almost had to call the fire department to put out the fire in my PC.

The game couldn’t maintain a stable 30 FPS even on low settings at 1080p. I tried 4K on ultra—oh boy. During cutscenes, when nothing was even moving, the FPS dropped to 5.

I tried reloading the game — crash.
Started it again, hit Continue — crash.
Started it again — no Continue, only New Game.
Loaded in and got stuck in a bush behind the first building.
Tried to go back to the main menu — crash.

Somehow, running it in windowed mode, I managed to play for about 60 minutes. There was no clear direction, no clear objectives. I only found one naked guy — and honestly, nothing about that was scary.

I expected my heart rate to rise, but the only things that went up were my CPU and GPU temperatures, desperately trying to load the next texture.

And that… was truly horrifying.
